sections.heading: Qualifacts Credible vs Kipu Health: Overview
sections.content: Qualifacts Credible and Kipu Health are both enterprise-grade EHRs for behavioral health but serve different primary markets. Credible is part of the Qualifacts portfolio (which includes CareLogic) and focuses on the largest behavioral health agencies, CCBHCs (Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics), and human services organizations with complex compliance and reporting needs. Kipu Health is ranked #1 in addiction medicine by Black Book Research and specializes in treatment centers handling detox, residential treatment, and medication-assisted treatment (MAT) programs. Both are substantial investments designed for organizations with complex requirements.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Both use enterprise/quote-based pricing. Credible starts at approximately $45,000/year with per-user costs of $100-200/month for smaller implementations, plus significant implementation fees ($5,000-$50,000+). Kipu ranges from $600-$10,000/month depending on facility size, with per-provider costs of $200-700/month. Neither offers free trials. Both require significant upfront investment and long-term commitment. Budget conservatively for implementation, training, and add-on modules with either platform.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: Credible excels in CCBHC compliance, state reporting, HIE integration, and supporting the most complex enterprise configurations with deep customization. Kipu specializes in addiction treatment workflows: comprehensive 42 CFR Part 2 compliance, MAT tracking (Suboxone, methadone, Vivitrol protocols), drug testing lab integration, and includes KipuCRM for patient acquisition. If your organization is a CCBHC or large community mental health center, Credible is likely the better fit. If you're running addiction treatment programs, Kipu has purpose-built workflows.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: The choice depends on your organization type:

recommendations.when: You're a CCBHC, large community mental health center, or human services agency with complex state reporting requirements and need deep enterprise customization
You operate addiction treatment facilities (residential, detox, MAT programs) and need specialized 42 CFR Part 2 compliance, MAT tracking, and treatment center CRM
You're a smaller organization—both are enterprise solutions. Consider CareLogic (mid-size) or outpatient solutions like Valant or TherapyNotes for smaller settings

faqs.q: What's the difference between Credible and CareLogic?
faqs.a: Both are Qualifacts products. Credible is designed for the largest and most complex organizations (enterprise agencies, multi-location, residential). CareLogic serves community mental health centers and mid-size organizations. Credible has deeper customization for the most complex requirements.

faqs.q: Is Kipu Health appropriate for outpatient-only programs?
faqs.a: Kipu can support outpatient programs but is designed primarily for treatment centers with residential, detox, and MAT components. Pure outpatient behavioral health practices may find Valant or AdvancedMD better fits with simpler pricing.

faqs.q: Which has better 42 CFR Part 2 compliance?
faqs.a: Kipu Health has deeper 42 CFR Part 2 compliance built specifically for addiction treatment records with specialized consent management and record segmentation. Credible offers Part 2 compliance but addiction treatment is not its primary focus.

faqs.q: Do either offer CRM for patient acquisition?
faqs.a: Kipu includes KipuCRM for treatment center admissions and patient acquisition. Credible does not have a native CRM module—you would need a separate solution for marketing and admissions tracking.
